_comment: Soft configuration for figure computations, multiple-comparison families, and historical manuscript reference values used by checks. Figure 4 uses the default MixedLM fits implemented by the figure generator.

figure_4.note: Current policy: default optimizer with no custom starting parameters. Effect estimates are stable; SE/z/p report the default fit.

dynamics_score.definition: log(d_ctrl / d_els) in 2D MDS space; ELS positive = control-like distance larger

figure_5.frequency_model: GEE NB (Fig 3A recipe) with 3 groups, dual-reference (Control-ref + ELS-ref)

panels.D-F: cross-cohort and full-session resilience prediction with Shapley contributions

figure_7.outcome: ELS resilient versus ELS vulnerable, defined by the Figure 5 dynamics score
figure_7.external_validation: train one cohort and test the other, both directions
figure_7.label_caveat: The outcome is derived from full-session behavior dynamics; early-window analyses therefore test how early that full-session label becomes recoverable.

behavior_classifier._scope: Bundled reusable classifier used by Figure 7A-C only.

cv.WARNING: frame-level split leaks temporal autocorrelation; animal-level split is the leakage-free option

behavior_classifier.feature_note: Only 5 bundled pose features available; full keypoint/pairwise-distance set is NOT in the repo

supplementary_figure_4.panels: Class-specific classifier SHAP, published as Figure 7 panels D-M
supplementary_figure_4.feature_space: Pairwise DeepLabCut body-part distances and velocities over a 14-marker skeleton (nose, H1R/H2R/H1L/H2L, B1R/B2R/B3R/B1L/B2L/B3L, tail, S1/S2), with lags and 5-frame rolling mean/SD/sum.

cv.WARNING: frame-level split leaks temporal autocorrelation; animal-level split is the leakage-free option

shap.sample: 10% of the balanced frame matrix, random_state=42

supplementary_figure_4.IMPORTANT: This is NOT the bundled classifier/figure7_behavior_classifier.joblib, which is a different model on a different 33-feature centroid-kinematic set and does not regenerate these panels. The 179 MB feature matrix and 58 MB SHAP pickles are not bundled; see scripts/import_legacy_shap_summary.py for their location and the import procedure.

gold_reference._source: Historical manuscript reference values only; not the current reporting policy.
